subject.title: BL-ecommerce-checkout: Cart & Checkout — specs, aislamiento y tests

question: Should the checkout BL block proceed as one owner-reviewed F1-F5 spin, or be split before extraction starts?
rationale: The BL workflow makes owner validation blocking, and the issue warns that the rule count may grow beyond the healthy block size.

options.title: Proceed as one block
options.body: Run F1 over cart and checkout, then have the owner validate all flags and rules before any isolation or tests.

options.title: Split before F1
options.body: Have the owner define narrower checkout sub-blocks first if the extracted rule count is likely to exceed a manageable F2 batch.

recommendation.title: Proceed as one block
recommendation.body: Run F1 over cart and checkout, then have the owner validate all flags and rules before any isolation or tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is both the named BL owner and current assignee.
